approval_state.description: whether the claim was approved, and by whom

currency.description: the currency both amounts are stated in

description.description: the tenant's description of what was purchased

evidence_reference.description: pointer to the receipt/invoice document the claim is substantiated by

expense_category.description: the tenant's own classification of the expense

external_id.description: the source system's own identifier for the claim submission

incurred_on.description: the date the expense was incurred, where the tenant form supplies it distinctly from the submission time

submitted_time.description: when the claim was submitted; the event time

worker_id.description: the worker who submitted the claim; the shelf's subject anchor
